overview_description.description:
SINAI Technologies builds enterprise decarbonization software to monitor, analyze, price, and reduce emissions. The company's tools enable organizations to automate carbon analysis and reporting for their entire operation, transforming the way they interact with their business, value chain, and the environment.

Founded in 2017, the company's mission is to provide organizations with the technology necessary to build deep decarbonization strategies.

about_short_description.short_description: SINAI Technologies builds enterprise decarbonization software to monitor, analyze, and reduce carbon emissions.

product.name: Carbon Accounting and Reporting
product.description: Software to standardize and simplify carbon accounting from equipment to corporate levels, supporting compliance with global standards like CDP, CSRD, and SBTi.

product.name: Climate Transition Planner
product.description: A tool to plan and visualize decarbonization pathways using AI-driven insights, interactive marginal abatement cost curves, and dynamic reduction scenarios aligned with corporate and global climate goals.

product.name: Climate Financial Planner
product.description: A financial modeling tool to assess the costs and prioritize mitigation projects, integrating financial impact with sustainability goals for data-driven decision-making.

product.name: Decarbonization Intelligence Portal
product.description: A data analytics and reporting platform integrated with Tableau that provides detailed carbon and financial data visualizations to track decarbonization progress and governance.

product.name: Utility Automation
product.description: An AI-driven SINAI platform capability that connects to utility providers or bills to turn consumption data into audit-ready emissions activity data across Scopes 1, 2, and 3.
